title: county-scaling-dynamics: code, result tables and figures for 'Unit turnover and yearly standardization create spurious attractor shifts in Langevin inference on open panels'
description:
Code, tests, result tables and figures accompanying the paper Unit turnover and yearly standardization create spurious attractor shifts in Langevin inference on open panels.

The archive contains the analysis code (panel construction, scaling-adjusted indices, Kramers–Moyal/Langevin estimation, the composition theory and simulation study, the US metropolitan and Brazilian municipal analyses and the controlled-masking experiment), the tests, every result table read by the scripts that write the paper's numbers and figures, and the figures as vector PDFs. make numbers and make figures regenerate them and make verify checks them against expected_outputs.sha256. The US and Brazilian analyses run end to end from public downloads (DATA_ACCESS.md lists sources and checksums). The Chinese county data come from a licensed database and are not redistributed.

Earlier versions: versions 1.x of this archive accompanied an earlier analysis of the same Chinese county panel. Its headline conclusions (the attractor shift and slowing down, and the single-factor values −0.46/+0.059) do not hold; the reasons are documented in the paper accompanying this version.
